resources.string: This install is the phone itself. It is not a website in a window. Nothing here is a Google, Meta, or Alphabet service.
Keep the passphrase and the seed off this phone. This phone unlocks with its own screen lock. It does not hold a seed or a passphrase. There is no backup location in this install.
Free: this device\'s own lock plus the bare TRV layer. That does not require a purchase.
TRV Token🍃 is a simulation only. It buys exclusive in-app customizations only. It is not money, not crypto, and not redeemable for cash. The amount is not set.
The only telemetry in this install is this phone\'s own GPS, and only when you ask. The fix stays on this phone. There is no analytics, no ad network, and no other location service.
The full MiMo-V2.6-Pro weights do not run on this phone. This install does not load them and does not run them. Nothing is sent off this phone. No paid host is used.
Stripe stays the card rail only. X Money and Phantom stay the other purchase rails. They are not replaced here, and none of them is this install.
This phone unlocks with its own screen lock. That lock is free. TRV does not replace it.
Set a screen lock in this phone\'s settings. TRV does not store a passphrase or a seed in its place.
Native GPS has not been read.
Location permission denied. This install will not use another location service.
This phone\'s GPS is off. Turn it on in system settings. No other provider is used.
No native GPS fix yet. The reading stays on this phone.
Native GPS %1$.3f, %2$.3f. Exclusive to this install. Not sent anywhere.
